changes.summary: the token foundation: off-white/off-black neutrals, a desaturated petrol primary, alpha-ink hairline borders, the documented radius scale (0.75rem / xl / pill), soft tinted shadow tokens, easing tokens, thinned Lucide strokes, a selection tint, and a fixed pointer-events-none grain layer (+ the shimmer keyframes).
the entrances move to the [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] bezier and a spring-feel pop; still transform-only.
one accent (color-mix hover), press physics (scale 0.98), custom easing instead of transition-all.
fields read as fields: a tinted surface, custom easing, a soft focus shadow.
soft tinted shadow + hairline ring instead of a flat 10% ring.
token-tinted overlay, shadow-lift, duration-300 with the expo bezier (no ease-in-out).
a transform-driven shimmer sweep instead of a pulse.
the sign-in screen: eyebrow pill, display type, a double-bezel motif, and a button-in-button pill CTA with a drifting arrow.
the new-workspace screen gains labels, an eyebrow, display type and the same CTA; the rail gets the sidebar surface.
a sticky, blurred, hairline bar (app toolbar, not a marketing nav).
initials avatars and a role chip; rows hover as cards.
a tighter header, rounded list rows, and a composed empty state with a glyph.
a mono pill page indicator; chevron/rotate glyphs become aria-hidden icons.
the rail becomes a pill with a hairline.
the banner takes the accent tint.

decisions: Replace the violet primary with petrol — the visible 'AI default' (LILA rule).
Hairline borders via alpha ink rather than a fixed grey.
One documented radius scale; pills for badges and primary CTAs.
Grain as a single fixed, pointer-events-none layer, off under prefers-reduced-transparency.
Lucide thinned globally by CSS rather than a new icon dependency.
